instrument: Virginia HB 153 (2026), Acts of Assembly Chapter 567, adding Code of Virginia § 15.2-2209.4
summary: Before approving a rezoning, special exception or special use permit for a new high energy use facility (100 MW or more), a locality shall require the applicant to submit a site assessment of the facility's sound profile on residences and schools within 500 feet of the property boundary; localities may also require assessment of effects on water, agriculture, parks, registered historic sites and forestland. Sets no noise limit, water cap or setback.

source.citation: Virginia LIS record for HB 153 (2026), Chapter 567, approved April 13, 2026 (title and approval date read from LIS; chapter text returned as binary); provision summary relayed from the LIS summary as reproduced by BillTrack50, and Roanoke Rambler, September 2026

notes: Resolves the pending HB 153 check: enacted. Signed by Governor Spanberger; companion SB 94; HB 153 incorporated HB 511. Third attempt after the 2025 version (HB 1601/SB 1449) was vetoed May 2, 2025. Does not apply to expansions at sites with existing approval unless the expansion adds 100 MW or more; does not supersede local zoning authority. Attaches at the approval endpoint only, consistent with the construction-interval finding.
